title: old dogs can learn … and so can young pups
excerpt: My daughter Rachel has three shiba inus. But when #3 came into the family, he and #1 couldn’t … get along. Now, as the pictures below show, they’ve become buddies. If two dogs – old and young, brown and white – can stop growling and scrapping, can’t people?
